#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_file ( original_name, store_name, extension, mime_type, file_size, file_path, source_type, author_name, source_url, license_url, copyright_notice, uploaded_by_user_no, uploaded_by_admin_no ) VALUES ( #{originalName}, #{storeName}, #{extension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{sourceType}, #{authorName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{licenseUrl}, #{copyrightNotice}, #{uploadedByUserNo}, #{uploadedByAdminNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_file SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_pet WHERE profile_file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_feed_media WHERE file_id = #{fileId} OR thumbnail_file_id = #{fileId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (file_id = #{fileId} OR thumbnail_file_id = #{fileId})) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_tag_image WHERE file_id = #{fileId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_tag_profile_request_image WHERE file_id = #{fileId})

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_pet p JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = p.user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_user_privacy v ON v.user_no = u.user_no WHERE p.profile_file_id = #{fileId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(v.private_account, 0) = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_feed_media m JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = m.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.visibility = 'PUBLIC' JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = f.user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_user_privacy v ON v.user_no = u.user_no WHERE (m.file_id = #{fileId} OR m.thumbnail_file_id = #{fileId}) AND COALESCE(v.private_account, 0) = 0 )
